opening.argument: The video depicts a speaker addressing a large audience gathered under a canopy, while the transcript identifies the event as a peasant movement and says farmers from Rajasthan, Punjab, and UP will come to Delhi. These are the observable features of a political or community gathering, not a financial or data-collection offer. The material discusses family and community attendance and protesters in that public-event context; it presents no offer to collect money or personal data. Its subject is general news, lifestyle, and entertainment, and the evidence supports treating it as non-scam content.

citations.quote: Pandit, you are boosting this peasant movement.
Rajasthan, Punjab, UP farmers, all of them will come to Delhi.
